name: Cyndaquil
description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Ember
moves.description: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.description: The user rolls into the target to deal damage, then becomes fixated on using this move.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.description: The user cloaks itself in flames and charges at the target to deal damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target at full power. The recoil from this move lowers the user’s offensive stats.
